name: claude-usage
description: Your Claude 5-hour and weekly quota in the status bar and a side view, read from the local Claude Usage Tracker.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Show the side view
Claude Usage: Open the widget in the browser
Claude Usage: Read the data again

claudeUsage.appFolder.markdownDescription: The tracker's `app` folder (the one with `run.py`). Empty: the folder this extension sits in, when it is run from `app/vscode`.

claudeUsage.source.markdownDescription: `file`: read `data/latest.json` directly (no network). `api`: ask the tracker's server (`/api/v1/latest`), for example a hub on another machine.

claudeUsage.apiUrl.description: Address of the tracker's server (source = api, and the Open the widget command).

claudeUsage.template.markdownDescription: Status bar text. `{b5}` `{p5}`: bars and % of the 5-hour window; `{b7}` `{p7}`: the same for the week.

claudeUsage.warnAt.description: Warning colour from this % (5-hour or week, the higher).

claudeUsage.intervalSeconds.description: How often to read again (the file is also watched).
